'''Tunnel worm''' were a type of [[Worm/Legends|worms]] living in the tunnels of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]]. They were employed as beast of burden by [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] and were also considered as a source of food.
